submission.justification: Mixture-G2 gave the best time resolution at every gap I simulated (1, 2 and 3 mm). The optimum is at about 2 mm, where it reached 0.88 ns. G3 reached 1.24 ns and G1 reached 2.03 ns at the same gap. I did not scan finer than 1 mm steps, so the true optimum could lie slightly off 2 mm. The project documents contain no environmental or safety policy, so I could not check compliance. G2 is the standard fluorinated mixture, and fluorinated gases commonly face greenhouse-gas restrictions. Before committing, someone should check G2 against the laboratory policy. If G2 fails that check, the fallback is G3 at 2 mm (1.24 ns).

requirements.evidence: G2 at 2 mm gave 0.88 ns. Other results: G2 1.04 ns at 1 mm and 1.07 ns at 3 mm; G3 1.47/1.24/1.50 ns at 1/2/3 mm; G1 2.16/2.03 ns at 1/2 mm.

requirements.requirement: Mixture is one of the three candidates
Gas system complies with environmental and safety policies
requirements.evidence: No policy document is in the project files. G2 is a standard fluorinated mixture, so its global-warming impact may be a concern. The planned recirculation has 90% recovery, which does not by itself show compliance.

requirements.requirement: Submit one recommended mixture and gap
